sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# The player is at node 0 (34, 13). Pressing UP should go to node 1 (28, 13).
# But the state_graph says UP has been tried from node 0, so it's being rejected as a "known" action.
# Let me try pressing UP with intent='re-explore' to bypass the state_graph check.

# First, let me check the current player position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        player = n
        break
if player:
    pc = (sum(p[0] for p in player['boundary'])//len(player['boundary']), sum(p[1] for p in player['boundary'])//len(player['boundary']))
    print(f"Current player position: {pc}")

# Try pressing UP with intent='re-explore'
result = action(['UP'], intent='re-explore')
print(f"\nAfter UP with intent='re-explore':")
print(f"  Result: {result}")

# Check new player position
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
player2 = None
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        player2 = n
        break
if player2:
    pc2 = (sum(p[0] for p in player2['boundary'])//len(player2['boundary']), sum(p[1] for p in player2['boundary'])//len(player2['boundary']))
    print(f"  New player position: {pc2}")
else:
    print("  No player found")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
